title: Kyle Shanahan: Mike Evans injury is not a long-term thing, hopeful he can play Sunday

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Kyle Shanahan: Mike Evans injury is not a long-term thing, hopeful he can play Sunday
sources.description: 49ers wide receiver Mike Evans had to leave Monday night's game because he aggravated the Achilles injury he has been dealing with, but coach Kyle Shanahan said after the game that they're optimistic Evans will play on Sunday against the Falcons.
